$comment: Blind rater AP on 307dbed, seed 2702, headed GPU driver 400x800 at 3x. Read only eval/RATING.md, docs/FUN_EVAL_IDLE.md, ../eval-fun/docs/FRAMEWORK.md sections 1-3 and the template (plus tools/driver.mjs header and eval/presets.json weights to operate/score). Did not open PLAN.md, research/, docs/CUT*.md, other cards or source. Audio: window.__audio shows cues (unlock, rule, slay) and a crypt drone firing, but I could not hear them, so audio is unassessed everywhere.

horizon.activeNote: wall clock: 34 min cold (the agent's turns are fast, so this covered 10 sends and 7 rule edits), then 17 min on return (6 sends, 3 own edits, 1 applied patch, a shopping pass); the 40/20 targets were not quite met by the clock, breadth was
horizon.runsWatchedNote: 5 at 1x start to end (runs 1, 2, 4, 6, 9), the rest in fights/fast mode; run 14 was meant to be 1x but the watch kept my earlier fast 4x choice
horizon.ruleEditsNote: 10 my own (drink unknown row, gas retreat, attack boss, bank threshold dial x3, dropped the kite card and wrote foe: ranged -> attack ranged, heavy retreat, on see hunger -> descend, foe: boss -> throw fire, adjacent >= 3 -> to corridor), 1 offered patch applied (the ORDER move); deaths read: 6 verdict screens (D5 GAP, D6 GAP, D4 GAP, D10 ROW, D13 GAP after return, D13 ORDER, D12 DICE)

criterion.delayedRecall: same-day: My fifth heir went in with a row I had just written, bank at 20% hp, and an attack-boss row that finally cracked the Goblin Warlord who had driven his father off at D8 ("WARLORD BREAKS", "GOBLIN WARLORD DOWN"). He pushed on through the Fens to D10 with $377 on him while a wraith ate his max hp down to 16, and then an ogre wound up. My bank row fired at 1 hp three turns running while the ogre swung, and the death screen said it plainly: "ogre · D10 · R3 bank", ROW - my rule, too late.

probes.clarity: The trace and the WHY sheet ("R1 hp < 30% → drink heal · 6/3537 acts · blocked · unknown item") told me what happened, but I wrote "on see hunger → descend" without seeing it was locked and only learned from a trace line "R3 descend · locked cond ← ◆2 cond: on see" after a death.
probes.decisions: I set my bank row to 40%, saw "bank 0→94% · death 99→6%" but "D6 ▼48", then tried 20% ("bank 69% · ~$130 · D9 −9") and 10% ("~$121") and kept 25%; I would make that call again.
probes.mastery: An hour ago I didn't know rules are first-match ("↑ R4" under my gas row taught me); now I place boss and crowd rows above attack nearest before I send.
probes.tension: At D13 with max hp eaten to 5 I watched "2/8 · 2/7 · 2/5 · descend · BANKED $620" and was actually holding my breath.
probes.feel: Callouts land on the moment: "OGRE WINDS UP", "R3 DESCEND" in big pixel type over three wraiths when my own row fired.
probes.surprise: The first wraith took max hp 36→27→16 and "The floor is hungry. It feeds on him." - that made me write the hunger → descend row.
probes.expression: My set reads like me: bank at a quarter, run from hunger, throw fire at bosses, back into a corridor when three crowd in.
probes.story: Heirs finding each other: "Found ♟1's bones: 12 items" then "Moreth the goblin archer is avenged." two runs after he killed my first heir.
probes.pacing: Runs are 45-175 s at the speeds I chose and a camp visit is 1-3 min, but after the absence every run became "Warlord down, bank at D10-13 on single-digit hp".
probes.failure: "goblin · D13 · R8 under R5" ORDER, with "move R8 above R5 · survives 11/12 · unpatched 0/12" - cause, margin and fix in one screen.
probes.social: No one else and no developing relationship; grudge names are flavour.
probes.autonomy: I chose to start at D9 to chase the Mother against a forecast saying "bank 78→25%", and died to dice at D12.
probes.progression: Rows 4→8, forge sword +2 / leather +1 / pack, supplies 3→5, auto keep weapon+armour, waystones D5/D9, ★1→★8 - but the D13 Mother ("12%") stayed out of reach.
probes.aesthetic: The painted camp banner and the torch-lit green Fens tiles with sprite wraiths; I'd sit in the Fens.
probes.return: I came back to "16 RUNS · D13 · 10 BANKED · 6 DEATHS · FIRST: MOTHER SLAIN · GRUDGE: ASHIM" and $3620, and spent five minutes deciding forge vs unlocks vs a fire row for the Mother; I did not wish I'd stayed.
probes.attribution: "R4 bank saved him." / "ogre · D10 · R3 bank" - my row saved him four times and killed him once, and I can say which.

axes.proxy: time-to-first-rule-edit; misread rate on the trace
axes.note: Evidence: "R1 hp < 30% → drink heal · 6/3537 acts · blocked · unknown item" and "↑ R4" shadow marks made first-match legible. Lapses that kept it off 0.8: a locked cond (on see) went into my row with no mark until a death trace; "survives 12/12 · unpatched 7/12 · reach D5 −76" I could not parse; "carry $215 · stalling" flashed mid-run with no reason; my kite card killing me was verdict GAP not ROW.

Evidence: the bank-threshold dial (40% "bank 0→94% · D6 ▼48" vs 20% "bank 69% · ~$130" vs 10% "~$121"), start D1/D5/D9 ("~$184 / ~$87 / ~$42"), 2 heals = "D8 35→67%". Named lapse: most of my own rows moved the forecast by "≈" only, and the forge showed sword +1 as "· …" until I'd paid, then showed leather "bank +19" - the better buy - too late.

Evidence: D5 → D6 → D8 → D10 → banked D13 in 10 sends as I learned first-match order, bank, attack boss. Plateau after return: D13 Mother at "12%" whatever I wrote; nothing new to learn surfaced in 17 min beyond the ORDER lesson.

Evidence: "2/8 · 2/7 · 2/5 · descend · BANKED $620" at D13 and "carry $377 · bank keeps $377 · death $0" on the HUD - stakes I chose via the bank row. Named lapse: after the absence the Warlord went down in ~6 s every time and banks at D10-13 on 3-9 hp became expected rather than sweated.

axes.proxy: frame time; events per minute at 1x
axes.note: Evidence: headed GPU, smooth; big pixel callouts "OGRE WINDS UP", "WARLORD BREAKS", "R3 DESCEND" land on the beat; no dead stretch over ~6 s in samples. Audio unassessed (cues fire in window.__audio; not heard). Kept at 0.6: fast/fights modes persist silently across sends, and several camp taps needed a second tap or a closed sheet to register.

axes.proxy: death-cause entropy; distinct situations per run
axes.note: Evidence: wraiths eating max hp ("The floor is hungry. It feeds on him.") changed my rules; bloats, eels across water, captives ("Cut the captive down. No one weeps."), monkeys stealing my sword. Repetition: the reel reprinted "Down to 4 HP. R3 bank saved him." three runs running and the same D8 Warlord every run.

Evidence: final set is mine (bank <25%, on see hunger → descend, foe: boss → throw fire, adjacent ≥ 3 → to corridor). Kept at 0.6: most of my stylistic rows forecast "≈", so the set converged on one shape (bank low, attack nearest last) any player would reach.

Evidence: "♟4 the greedy fighter · D10 · took the Warlord · fell to an ogre"; grudges and avengings across heirs (Moreth, Drim, Skix, Ashim), "Found ♟1's bones". Named lapse: the post-absence reel is generic ("Banked $479.", "D13: the Fens.") and repeats per run.

axes.proxy: run length; check-in length; dead time at 1x
axes.note: In-run: 45-175 s runs, lines every 3 s sample, no dead stretch. Check-in: 1-3 min between sends; return check-in ~5 min then natural stop. Administration friction: forge needs two taps, sheets overlap tiles, patches push rows and shadow others ("↑ R5") so I re-ordered by hand. Cadence repetition after return keeps it at 0.6.

axes.proxy: share of deaths with a matched-rule trace
axes.note: Evidence: "ogre · D10 · R3 bank" ROW, "goblin · D13 · R8 under R5" ORDER with "survives 11/12 · unpatched 0/12", DICE with "nothing beats"; next heir ready at once. Named lapse: the Warlord drive-off "driven $0 · $297 lost" with hp 25/36 had no verdict screen and felt like a death; my own card's retreat loop was called GAP.

Evidence: I picked start depth (D9 push against "bank 78→25%"), bank vs push threshold, class (stayed fighter, rogue owned), what to forge. Goals are self-set but the gold economy pushes one answer (start D1, bank low).

Within-run: kit, levels (L1→L5), max hp swings. Persistent: rows 4→8, forge, pack, supplies 3→5, waystones, ★8, ledger fills. Automation: "repeat on · held ≤$78" restock, auto keep weapon+armour, "found fire → supplies". Named lapse: D13 Mother wall - forecast 8-12% after every purchase.

Evidence: painted camp banner, parchment sheets, green torch-lit Fens with readable sprites. Audio unassessed. Chrome is dense text ("carry $X · bank keeps $X · death $0 · bank at 25%") over the scene.

axes.proxy: offline yield vs active; decisions pending on return
axes.note: Evidence: "16 RUNS · D13 DEEPEST · 10 BANKED · 6 DEATHS · FIRST: MOTHER SLAIN", "+$3086 banked · −$520 spent · $2725 lost", PENDING forge ×3 + unlocks, a verdict per death, learned "bloat mother · counter: throw fire" -> I wrote the fire row. First action < 30 s. Named lapse: the reel's five death lines are the same shape ("X cornered him to N HP; R5 retreated; died to ogre") and the waystone start that the return offered earns less gold.

axes.proxy: share of deaths attributable to a rule the player wrote
axes.note: Evidence: "R4 bank saved him.", the "R3 DESCEND" callout when my hunger row fired, "ogre · D10 · R3 bank" - I tell runs in first person ("my bank row fired too late"). Named lapse: when my free card (kite archers) looped retreat into two archers the verdict said GAP, and the locked cond sat silently in my row.
